author: Good Enough
description:
Barbers once performed some of the most dangerous surgeries of the Middle Ages. Medieval barber-surgeons could amputate badly injured or diseased limbs using crude tools, often without modern anesthesia, antibiotics, sterile operating rooms, or reliable ways to control infection and blood loss.

These amputations could sometimes save a life, but the procedure itself was extremely painful and dangerous, and survival depended heavily on how quickly the surgery was performed and whether complications developed afterward.

This Short explores medieval amputations, barber-surgeons, medieval surgery, medical history, and the terrifying reality of losing a limb before modern medicine.
title: Barbers Actually Did This 🦴😰 #didyouknow #medieval #history #facts
